answer_2.quote: We introduce a new metric we called Tokenization Syntax Errors (TSE).

answer_4.quote: We gathered nine participants, among which seven are musicians, to evaluate the results. ... They were asked to assess fidelity, correctness, diversity, and overall preference.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters listened to generated MIDI files and rated them on fidelity, correctness, diversity, and overall preference.
